sections.h2: How to use a PUMA promo code
sections.html:
1. Pick an offer above and tap Get code to reveal and copy it (deals and member perks need no code).
  2. Open us.puma.com, add the items you want to your cart and check they meet the offer's terms.
  3. Paste the code into the promo or discount box at checkout and check the price drops before you pay.

• Multi-buy codes reward bigger baskets: check whether adding one more item unlocks a better tier.
  • Banner codes change often, so check the end date on PUMA's site before you buy.

faqs.q: Is there a PUMA discount code right now?
faqs.a: Yes. As of 16 Oct 2026 we found this code on us.puma.com: STOCKUP (30% off when you buy 3, 20% off when you buy 2). Codes can end without notice, so the store's checkout has the final word.

faqs.q: How does VoucherVault check PUMA codes?
faqs.a: We only list offers we have seen on PUMA's own site or app, or in its official affiliate feed, and show the date we last checked each one. Offers with a published end date disappear when it passes; offers without one are hidden if we haven't re-checked them recently.

faqs.q: Why isn't my PUMA code working?
faqs.a: The usual reasons are: the code only covers selected items, you haven't reached a minimum spend, it is for new customers or app orders only, it can't be combined with another offer, or it has just ended. Read the terms on the offer and check your basket meets them.
